basic_info.description: Welcome to Mission Crown! Residence 3447 is an expansive house-like flat with soaring ceilings, open kitchen and a classic Queen Anne style. Four bedrooms (plus office) and 2.5 bathrooms provide ample flexibility of space. In-unit laundry is included. Enjoy all the charm and character of a classic San Francisco building, with modern features and updates ideal for today's living needs. Mission Crown is a stunning collection of extensively remodeled residences housed behind a restored historic Victorian facade. The extensive building remodel includes new electrical, plumbing, seismic retrofitting and new foundations. A common roof deck provides stunning views of the downtown skyline. Experience the vibrant Mission District with world-class dining, nightlife, and numerous shopping options right at your doorstep. Easily walkable to the Valencia corridor and the bustling 20th street restaurant scene. Nearby access to public transit makes exploring the city a breeze!
